questions.question: Return portfolio_name and number of holdings for each portfolio, alphabetically by portfolio_name.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name,COUNT(h.holding_id) FROM portfolios p LEFT JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) GROUP BY p.portfolio_id ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: Return portfolio_name for portfolios holding AAPL, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h USING(portfolio_id) JOIN securities s USING(security_id) WHERE s.symbol='AAPL' ORDER BY p.portfolio_name
